description: This Java source file defines the class ReferencePlaceholder, responsible for parsing and holding information about entity references embedded in placeholder strings. It extracts entity type, entity ID, and referenced field from placeholder inputs modeled via regex matching.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholder
classes.description: Immutable class representing a referenced entity placeholder, capable of parsing its components from a string.

methods.name: fromCharSequence
methods.description: Parses an input string to identify and construct a ReferencePlaceholder object if the string matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: getReferencedEntityType
methods.description: Returns the type of the referenced entity.

methods.name: getReferencedEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID of the referenced entity.

methods.name: getReferencedField
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the referenced field.
